items.title: ¿Hay puente o se trabaja el lunes 2 de noviembre de 2026? Esto dice la Ley del Trabajo
items.author: Zenyazen Flores, Italia López
items.summary: De acuerdo con la Ley del Trabajo, el lunes 2 de noviembre de 2026 no está considerado como día de descanso obligatorio. Es decir, el lunes 2 de noviembre no es un día oficial festivo ni de descanso ...
items.body: Ciudad de México — El Día de Muertos en México es una fecha para celebrar y recordar a los seres queridos que han fallecido. Esta tradición coincide con el calendario católico: el 1 de noviembre corresponde al Día de Todos los Santos, y el 2 de noviembre al de los Fieles Difuntos. Este 2026, el 1 de noviembre será domingo y 2 de noviembre caerá en lunes. Durante los días de esta celebración, que simboliza el regreso de los espíritus de los muertos al mundo de los vivos a través de ofrendas, se suspenden las clases para estudiantes desde el nivel básico hasta el superior y algunos trabajadores también descansan. Por ello, suelen surgir dudas sobre si se trata de días festivos oficiales o si se trabajará de forma normal. Ver más: ¿Abrirán los bancos el lunes 2 de noviembre por Día de Muertos? La Ley Federal del Trabajo (LFT) establece en el Artículo 74 que son días de descanso obligatorio: De acuerdo con la Ley del Trabajo, el lunes 2 de noviembre de 2026 no está considerado como día de descanso obligatorio. Es decir, el lunes 2 de noviembre no es un día oficial festivo ni de descanso obligatorio, por lo que no hay puente para los trabajadores. Algunas empresas acuerdan con sus empleados no trabajar el lunes 2 de noviembre, pero ello dependerá de los contratos de trabajo particulares. En noviembre, solo hay un día de descanso obligatorio contemplado en la ley: el tercer lunes de noviembre en conmemoración del 20 de noviembre por el aniversario de la Revolución Mexicana. En 2026, este feriado será el lunes 16 de noviembre. Los estudiantes de educación básica sí tendrán puente este lunes 2 de noviembre, regresando a clases el martes 3 de noviembre, de acuerdo con el Calendario Oficial de la SEP 2026-2027. Quienes trabajan en entidades financieras sujetas a la supervisión del regulador Comisión Nacional Bancaria y de Valores (CNBV), entre ellas los bancos, casas de bolsa, bolsas de valores o intermediarios financieros no bancarios como las sofipos, sí descansarán el lunes 2 de noviembre de 2026. Esto de acuerdo con las disposiciones publicadas por la CNBV en el Diario Oficial de la Federación, que establecen las fechas en que los trabajadores de estas entidades deben cerrar sus puertas y suspender operaciones.

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Kentaro Sugiyama

［東京　２日　ロイター］ - 片山さつき財務相は２日の閣議後会見で、３日の米中間選挙...
items.body:
市場に無秩序な動きや投機的動きあれば対応＝米中間選挙で片山財務相
10:03 配信

片山さつき財務相。10月21日、都内で撮影。 REUTERS/Issei Kato（ロイター） Kentaro Sugiyama

［東京　２日　ロイター］ - 片山さつき財務相は２日の閣議後会見で、３日の米中間選挙の結果を受けてマーケットに無秩序な動きや過度に投機的な動きがあれば、通貨当局として対応すると語った。

片山氏は、中間選挙の結果次第で市場にさまざまな変化が起こり得るが、即座に大統領や閣僚が交代することはなく、大臣自身のカウンターパートも変わらないと指摘。これまで日米の通貨当局が確認している覚書に沿って行動すると述べた。

日米協調介入を含めた一連の通貨政策の振り返りと、今後の政府のスタンスに関する質問には「為替の動向、特に具体的な数字について申し上げられない」とした。

一方、日米首脳会談で首脳同士が議論し、高市早苗首相も円の過小評価は問題だと指摘している、と説明。蔵相同士も電話会談しており、覚書を踏まえて行動する時は行動すると語った。

片山氏は「いろいろな意味でマクロ的な考え方は両国合っていると思うので、引き続き緊密にコミュニケーションをとっていく」と語った。その上で「秩序ある為替市場であることが重要だ」と強調し、「そこのところは今の状態を含めて前よりは改善はしているのではないか」と述べた。

items.title: 香港ＨＫＴ、米国で通信事業停止へ　ＦＣＣの圧力受け合意
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
David Shepardson

[ワシントン ３０日 ロイター] - 香港の大手通信事業者で、ＰＣＣＷ傘下のＨＫＴは...
items.body:
香港ＨＫＴ、米国で通信事業停止へ　ＦＣＣの圧力受け合意
9:41 配信

7月22日、米ワシントンのＦＣＣ本部で撮影。 REUTERS/Kylie Cooper（ロイター） David Shepardson

[ワシントン ３０日 ロイター] - 香港の大手通信事業者で、ＰＣＣＷ傘下のＨＫＴは３０日、米連邦通信委員会（ＦＣＣ）の圧力を受け、米国での事業を停止することで合意した。

ＦＣＣは２０２５年１０月、国家安全保障上の懸念と、ＰＣＣＷの株主である中国聯通（チャイナ・ユニコム）との関係を理由に、ＨＫＴの米国事業認可を取り消す手続きを進めると発表していた。ロイターが確認した取り決めによると、ＨＫＴは米国向けの国際通信サービスと、米国内で提供する国内通信サービスを停止することで合意した。

ＨＫＴは３０日以内にＦＣＣに対してサービスの終了を申請し、２７年９月１日までに米国でのサービスを停止する必要がある。今回の合意により、ＦＣＣはＨＫＴの認可取り消しの手続きを見送る。ＰＣＣＷは直ちにコメントすることを控えた。

ＦＣＣはこれまでに、中国移動（チャイナ・モバイル） 、中国電信（チャイナ・テレコム） 、中国聯通の３社について、幅広い国家安全保障上の懸念を理由に、米国向けの国際通信サービスの提供を禁止している。

トランプ政権はこの１年間、中国の通信企業に対する厳しい締め付けを続けている。ＦＣＣは２９日、中国の全試験機関による米国向け電子機器の試験を２８年１２月から禁止することを決定した。また同日には国家安全保障上の理由から、中国の通信企業が米国の電話番号に直接アクセスすることを近く禁止する方針も発表した。

ＦＣＣはさらに、中国通信企業による米通信網への接続や米国内データセンターの運営を禁止することも検討している。

中国は米国による通信分野での一連の規制強化に強く反発している。３０日には試験機関に関するＦＣＣの措置に断固反対すると表明。「米国が一方的な行動を続けるなら、必要な対抗措置を取る」と警告した。

Shares steady as Apple earnings near, oil eases

FILE PHOTO: Bull statues are placed in font of screens showing the Hang Seng stock index and stock prices outside Exchange Square, in Hong Kong, China, August 18, 2023. REUTERS/Tyrone Siu/File Photo

FAST

SYDNEY, Nov 2 : Share markets steadied in Asia on Monday as investors hoped for Apple earnings later in the day to provide some relief from AI cash-burn worries, while oil prices eased after talks continued between Iranian and Qatari mediators.
Apple has been an oasis of relative calm given it does not spend billions on data centres, and its shares have climbed for four months straight to help it unseat Nvidia as the world's most valuable listed company.
Analysts are looking for quarterly earnings per share (EPS) of $2 on revenue of $113 billion, up from $1.85 the same time last year. The company might also offer some guidance on how early sales of the iPhone 18 are performing with pre-orders having started in mid-October.
The optimism helped S&P 500 futures edge up 0.4 per cent, while Nasdaq futures bounced 0.8 per cent. The tech-heavy Nasdaq lost almost 7 per cent in October for its worst month since the 'Liberation Day' tariff rout of April 2025.

Some upbeat news is sorely needed after concerns about negative cash flow and the sheer scale of AI capex saw the cost of insuring against corporate defaults blow out last week.
Intel's near 29 per cent tumble on Friday has also raised the stakes for other chip groups, including AMD.
An added wrinkle is the midterm elections in the United States, where a win by Democrats in either or both houses could result in more political hurdles for data centres.
Analysts at Goldman Sachs expect capex by hyperscalers to almost double to $800 billion this year, and rise further to $1.2 trillion in 2027. At the same time, they see S&P 500 EPS growth of nearly 30 per cent in 2026 slowing to 18 per cent next year.
"Earnings results have underscored the fundamental challenge facing equity investors — earnings growth is strong, but it is no longer accelerating," wrote Ben Snider, Goldman's chief US equity strategist, in a note.
"Similarly, Q3 results support our view that AI investment spending will continue to grow but that the growth rate of AI capex is peaking."
Adding to the air of unease were withdrawals from Binance as the world's biggest cryptocurrency exchange went back online on Sunday after hackers stole billions from the platform last week.
Japan's Nikkei was down 0.1 per cent, but off early lows, while South Korea added 0.8 per cent, having shed 16 per cent last month. MSCI's broadest index of Asia-Pacific shares outside Japan eased 0.2 per cent.
In Europe, EUROSTOXX 50 futures and DAX futures both firmed 0.1 per cent, while FTSE futures were flat. 
MORE RATE HIKES COMING
The retreat in equities last month provided a reprieve to safe-haven bonds, with investors wondering if a sustained selloff in the stock market could deter the Federal Reserve from hiking interest rates in December.
Futures still imply a 72 per cent chance of a quarter-point rate rise, but now only have 55 basis points of total tightening priced in compared to more than 70 basis points a month ago.
Yields on 10-year Treasuries nudged up to 4.941 per cent, but remained well off their October peak of 5.3645 per cent, while 2-year yields stood at 4.612 per cent.
Among central banks meeting this week, markets are wagering on hikes from the Reserve Bank of Australia, Bank of England and Riksbank, while the Norges Bank is seen on hold.
Economic data due this week includes the influential US ISM survey of manufacturing for October later on Monday, while the all-important payrolls report is on Friday.
Median forecasts are for a 65,000 rise in jobs, after September's disappointing 29,000 gain, with the unemployment rate holding at 4.2 per cent.
In currency markets, the majors were pretty much sidelined while all the action was concentrated in stocks. The euro was a shade firmer at $1.1169, while the dollar was barely changed at 157.75 yen.
For commodities, oil prices slipped as talks continued aimed at pushing for a deal to end the US-Israeli war on Iran, though tankers were still being attacked in the Gulf.
Brent futures dipped 2.0 per cent to $111.15 a barrel, though that follows a 13.6 per cent jump in October, while US crude futures eased 2.3 per cent to $101.73 a barrel.
Non-interest-bearing gold bounced 0.9 per cent to $3,911 an ounce, having fallen 6.8 per cent last month amid talk some investors were having to sell to cover margin calls on equities. [GOL/]

items.title: 豪住宅価格が7カ月連続下落、過去40年で最も急速
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [シドニー ２日 ロイター] - オーストラリアの住宅価格は１０月まで７カ月連続で下がり、下落ペースは過去４０年で最も急...
items.body:
豪住宅価格が7カ月連続下落、過去40年で最も急速
9:36 配信

9月1日、シドニーの住宅街から中心部を撮影。 REUTERS/Hollie Adams（ロイター） [シドニー ２日 ロイター] - オーストラリアの住宅価格は１０月まで７カ月連続で下がり、下落ペースは過去４０年で最も急速となった。住宅市場にとっては、追加利上げ観測の高まりがさらなる痛手となっている。

不動産データ会社コタリティが２日公表した統計によると、１０月の全国住宅価格指数は前月比１．２％下落した。９月の下落率は従来の１．３％減に下方修正され、住宅価格はピーク時から６．７％、前年同月比では２．８％それぞれ下落した。

同社によると、主要都市圏の住宅価格は過去７カ月間で下落率が８．１％と過去４０年で最も速いペースを記録。新型コロナウイルス禍後のインフレ抑制を目的にオーストラリア準備銀行（ＲＢＡ、中央銀行）が大幅な利上げを実施した２０２２－２３年の同期間の下落率７．０％を上回った。

１０月は中規模都市で下落が目立ち、ブリスベンの住宅価格は前月比２．０％、パースは１．７％それぞれ下落した。両都市は過去５年間でおよそ５０％上昇していたが、その上昇分の一部が失われた。シドニーの住宅価格は１０月に１．６％下落し、５年前の水準を１．５％下回った。

コタリティの調査責任者ティム・ローレス氏は「買い手はより多くの物件から選択でき、交渉力も高まっている。１年前のように価格上昇を見越して急いで購入する状況ではなくなった」と指摘した。

その上で「買い手市場となっているにもかかわらず購入者の動きは鈍く、消費者心理の低迷や借り入れ能力の制約が続いていることを反映している」と述べた。

住宅販売も低調で、取引件数は前年同月比２３％減となり、過去５年平均を１８％下回った。特にシドニーでは取引件数が前年同月比３０％減と落ち込みが大きかった。

市場では、ＲＢＡが次回理事会で政策金利を０．２５ポイント引き上げ、１８年ぶりの高水準となる４．８５％にすることを決めるとみられている。想定される利上げ確率は約９０％で、政策金利が５．１％に達する可能性も２０％程度見込まれている。

ＲＢＡは住宅市場の低迷を景気の下振れリスクと位置付ける一方、金融システムの安定性への影響については限定的との見方を示している。住宅価格が２０％下落した場合でも、大半の住宅ローン保有者は資産価値が負債額を上回る「含み益」を維持できるという。

中国ＥＶ大手ＢＹＤ、輸出好調で6カ月連続販売増
9:28 配信

10月14日、韓国ソウルのショールームに展示されたBYDの電気自動車。 REUTERS/Kim Soo-hyeon（ロイター） [北京 １日 ロイター] - 中国電気自動車（ＥＶ）大手の比亜迪（ＢＹＤ）は１０月、販売台数が６カ月連続で増加した。国内市場の需要低迷や激しい価格競争による打撃を海外市場で補った。

同社が１日に開示した情報に基づくロイターの算定によると、１０月の販売台数は前年同月比１１％増の４９万０１６８台となり、９月の同１７％増からは伸びが減速したものの、海外への出荷台数は同１０２．８％増の１７万０１９４台となった。

• 第３・四半期利益の伸びは前年同期比２８％に鈍化し、予想を下回った。国内需要の弱さの中で業界全体が輸出市場への進出を加速させた結果、競争が激化したことが要因。

• 欧州連合（ＥＵ）へのハイブリッド車輸出の主要輸出企業であるＢＹＤは、ハイブリッド車の輸入抑制を目的とした中国・ＥＵ間の協定に基づき、新たな規制に直面する可能性がある。

• 中国の国内自動車市場は、今年の予想以上の大幅な落ち込みを経て、２０２７年には緩やかな回復を迎える見通しだ。

主力株はトヨタ自動車7203.Tが小安い一方、ソニーグループ6758.Tは小高い。指数寄与度の高いファーストリテイリング9983.Tは横ばい。

items.title: Restrepo dice que Colombia corre el riesgo de entrar en impago si no se adopta una solución fiscal
items.author: Maria Clara Cobo
items.summary: Colombia se enfrenta a unas perspectivas fiscales complicadas tras años de elevado gasto público y escasos ingresos fiscales.
items.body: Bloomberg — Colombia corre el riesgo de entrar en situación de impago si el Congreso no aprueba un proyecto de ley de ajuste fiscal, afirmó el vicepresidente José Manuel Restrepo en una entrevista concedida a la revista local Semana , advirtiendo de que el país se enfrenta a una grave crisis económica sin las medidas propuestas. “Si Colombia no saca adelante este proyecto de ley de rescate antes de que termine el año, el país entrará en situación de impago el año que viene”, afirmó Restrepo, quien calificó la legislación de esencial para restablecer la estabilidad fiscal y garantizar que el Gobierno pueda cumplir con sus obligaciones financieras. Ver más: Deuda, dólar y acciones: las señales que envían los inversionistas sobre Colombia Colombia se enfrenta a unas perspectivas fiscales complicadas tras años de elevado gasto público y escasos ingresos fiscales. El Gobierno estima que, sin un ajuste fiscal, el déficit presupuestario podría superar el 9% del producto interior bruto el próximo año. El proyecto de ley de rescate económico, la propuesta legislativa más ambiciosa hasta la fecha del presidente Abelardo de la Espriella, dotaría al Gobierno de herramientas para recortar o aplazar el gasto ineficiente, revisar los ingresos asignados a fines específicos y los fondos especiales, y reorganizar la administración pública. La mayor parte del ajuste proviene del aumento de los impuestos y otras medidas destinadas a incrementar los ingresos. El proyecto de ley se enfrentó a una oposición inicial, principalmente por las subidas de impuestos propuestas, ya que los legisladores sostienen que los colombianos no pueden permitirse una mayor carga fiscal a medida que aumentan las presiones económicas. Los miembros del Centro Democrático, el mayor partido de la coalición gubernamental en el Senado, han afirmado que apoyarían los recortes de gasto y una reducción del tamaño del Estado, pero se oponen a nuevos impuestos. Sin el ajuste propuesto, Colombia podría enfrentarse a una recesión, a un aumento de la inflación e incluso, potencialmente, a una hiperinflación, afirmó Restrepo. También advirtió de que más de un millón de personas podrían caer en la pobreza y de que el Gobierno podría tener dificultades para financiar operaciones básicas, incluida la elaboración de un presupuesto nacional. El país se enfrenta a un déficit de financiación de entre 80 billones (US$25.000 millones) y 90 billones de pesos colombianos, señaló Restrepo, subrayando la urgencia de abordar la situación fiscal del Gobierno. Si no se aprueba la legislación, se socavaría aún más la confianza de los inversores y se pondría en peligro la sostenibilidad de las finanzas públicas, añadió. Ver más: Deuda de Colombia llegará a máximo histórico en 2027: debe financiar COP$266 billones El Gobierno aprobó el presupuesto para 2027 por decreto el mes pasado, fijando el gasto en 635 billones de pesos colombianos, una medida que ha suscitado inquietud entre los inversores. “Una moneda que inspira confianza tiene dos caras: la del ajuste fiscal y la del crecimiento económico”, afirmó Restrepo. “O nos salvamos o estamos perdidos. No hay otras alternativas”. Con la colaboración de Óscar Medina. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

items.title: Ｓ＆Ｐ、メタ見通し「ネガティブ」に引き下げ　巨額投資と現金創出に懸念
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [３０日 ロイター] - 米格付け会社Ｓ＆Ｐグローバル・レーティングは３０日、米メタ・プラットフォームズの格付け見通しを...
items.body:
Ｓ＆Ｐ、メタ見通し「ネガティブ」に引き下げ　巨額投資と現金創出に懸念
7:47 配信

写真はメタのロゴ。2025年1月、スイスのダボスで撮影。REUTERS/Yves Herman（ロイター） [３０日 ロイター] - 米格付け会社Ｓ＆Ｐグローバル・レーティングは３０日、米メタ・プラットフォームズの格付け見通しを「安定的」から「ネガティブ」に引き下げた。人工知能（ＡＩ）関連投資に伴う巨額の設備投資とフリー営業キャッシュフロー（ＦＯＣＦ）の先行きに対する不確実性を理由としている。

大手テクノロジー企業はこれまでもクラウドコンピューティングやオンライン広告、電子商取引分野で多額の投資を行ってきたが、ＡＩブームにより設備投資額は一段と拡大している。投資家の間では、こうした投資が十分な収益を生み出せるかどうかを巡る懸念が強まっている。

メタは先に、年間の設備投資見通しを１３５０億─１４５０億ドルと公表した。第３・四半期には２１億２０００万ドルのフリーキャッシュフロー赤字を計上したほか、ＡＩ基盤整備の資金調達に向けて公募市場を活用し、９７５億ドル規模の株式売却を計画している。

Ｓ＆ＰはメタのＡＩ投資の収益化能力が同業他社に比べて限定的だと分析し、今後数年間でＡＩ関連の新たな収益源が、増加するコストを上回る水準まで成長する時期は不透明だと付け加えた。

またＳ＆ＰはメタのＦＯＣＦ赤字が２０２６年に３９０億ドル、２７年に７１０億ドルに達すると予想。高水準の設備投資が続けば、２８年以降もＦＯＣＦがマイナス圏にとどまる可能性があるとし、２８年の資金不足は全額借入金で賄われると見込んでいる。

Ｓ＆Ｐは「将来の設備投資計画や極めて野心的な複数年にわたるＡＩ投資計画について不透明感が強く、従来想定していたほど支出が抑制されるとの確信を持てなくなった」と述べた。

さらにメタのレバレッジ比率は早ければ２７年に１．０倍を超えてもおかしくない可能性があると言及した。１．０倍超えが続けば、現在の「ＡＡ－」格付け維持は難しくなる恐れが出てくる。

これに対しメタの広報担当者はロイターに「Ｓ＆ＰによるＡＩ収益化能力に関する見解には同意しない。当社には大きな製品機会と事業機会があり、強固な信用力を支えている」とコメントした。

Ｓ＆Ｐによると、メタのレバレッジ比率は２５年の０．１倍から上昇した。これは社債発行ではなく、データセンター容量をリースで確保する戦略を採用していることが主因という。

Ｓ＆Ｐグローバル・レーティングの米メディア・通信セクター責任者、ナビーン・サルマ氏は「設備投資が高水準のまま拡大を続ければ、信用力の低下とキャッシュフローの悪化が続くだろう」と警告した。

メタの９月３０日時点の長期負債残高は８０９億２０００万ドルだった。

Ｓ＆Ｐは２９日、半導体大手ブロードコムの格付け見通しも「ポジティブ」から「安定的」に引き下げた。ＡＩ関連事業の急成長により、一部の大口顧客への依存度が高まっていることを理由としている。

MEXICO CITY: Formula One's youngest champion Kimi Antonelli has nothing to prove and could be one of the greats, according to his Mercedes team boss Toto Wolff.
The 20-year-old clinched the title in Mexico City on Sunday (Nov 1) to also become the first Italian F1 world champion in 73 years.
Wolff, whose team took Britain's Lewis Hamilton to six of his seven championships and also Germany's Nico Rosberg to the crown in 2016, told Reuters Antonelli had exceeded all expectations and was likely to take more titles in years to come.
"If we provide him a car in the future then he's not going to be a one-hit wonder," said the Austrian ahead of Sunday's race.

"And if someone else provides him with a car in the future, and we are not able, then he's going to win.
"He has all the ingredients of putting himself in a league with the great ones."
FERRARI INTEREST NOT A CONCERN  Wolff said he was not worried about any rising clamour in Italy for Ferrari, the sport's most successful and historic team but without a title of any sort since 2008, to try and sign his driver.
"Fair enough as a question, no?" he said, speaking in his paddock office.
"You can imagine that for a young Italian, in a Ferrari, that might be a topic one day. But the truth is, he knows and appreciates so much the role we played in the past. When we picked him up from 11, how we supported him. There is so much recognition and appreciation for having been with us.
"I think we have a very long contract with him. I would have no doubt of him driving for us even without a contract. Even with a car that wouldn't be able to win championships, because he has that appreciation with what we've achieved together.
"Now, will there be in the future an interest to drive for Ferrari? Maybe there will be, but you just need to recognise."
Antonelli had a difficult debut season in 2025, with Wolff saying he had faced quite a backlash from other drivers and their managers over his decision to bring in someone so young.

Related:

Kimi Antonelli becomes youngest F1 champion at 20 years old

He recalled some saying it was a joke for such a seemingly raw rookie to go straight into a top team, with others "bombarding" him with messages saying it was reckless and irresponsible and Antonelli needed another year in Formula Two.
"And then I heard that all year long last year: 'You saw it was a mistake. He's too young. He's too up and down.'"
None of the critics had apologised, said the Austrian.
NOTHING TO PROVE Antonelli has won nine races, including five in a row. He triumphed at his home Italian Grand Prix by coming from the back of the field and also stood on top of the podium in Monaco and Spa, two of the classics any driver yearns to have on their resume.
Wolff said none of this should have come as a surprise to those who had seen what Antonelli did in the junior series or were aware of how much nurturing and preparation Mercedes had done over the past nine years, spending millions along the way.
"This kid has nothing to prove any more," Wolff said, listing Antonelli's domination in karting and titles in single-seaters. 
"He has nothing to prove any more because he's proven the last eight years that he's been the best."
The Austrian said champions like Hamilton and Red Bull's Max Verstappen recognised immediately the arrival of a new talent and threat.
"When you see the interaction between Max and Kimi, and Lewis and Kimi, it's always like 'game recognises game'," he added. "From the first time Kimi came on track, Max recognised. And they see it by following. You can see it's different."
Wolff said he also had no worries that Antonelli's head might be turned by fame and fortune or by wanting to enjoy the fruits of his success.
"We have a good structure around him," he said. "We've built a wall around him. His family, he has all the right values. He has the right mentors around. I think we're shielding him against possible influences. 
"You know, he finds it quite astonishing that people ask for autographs or selfies. He's like 'Really? Is that happening to me?' So I don't think he's at risk of becoming the kind of flamboyant young superstar. It's not going to happen."

items.body:
ソフトバンクＧ出資のオーペイ、米ＩＰＯ撤回　「外国当局の調査」理由
7:33 配信

写真はオーペイのロゴ。10月30日、米ニューヨーク証券取引所で撮影。REUTERS/Brendan McDermid（ロイター） ［３０日　ロイター］　 - ソフトバンクグループが出資するデジタル決済会社オーペイは３０日、米国での３億０４００万ドル規模の新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）計画を撤回した。外国の規制当局による調査を理由に挙げたが、国・地域名は明らかにしなかった。

ナイジェリアを主力市場とする同社は、調査が主要事業にとって「重要性の低い」国・地域に関するものだと説明した。声明では、規制当局の名称や調査内容には触れなかった。

オーペイは、この問題が近い将来、満足のいく形で解決すると見込んでいると説明。調査について「当社の業績、財務状況、業務の健全性、規制上の地位を反映するものと誤解すべきではない」と表明した。

また、ナイジェリアやその他の市場での事業運営、規制上の地位、顧客サービスには影響しないとした。

オーペイは同日、米国預託株式（ＡＤＳ）１６００万株の公開価格を、仮条件の１９─２１ドルの下限となる１株１９ドルに設定したと発表していた。この価格に基づく企業評価額は約４０億ドル。

ソフトバンクＧは、コメント要請に直ちに回答しなかった。同社は傘下の事業体を通じてＩＰＯ前の時点でオーペイ株の６．６％を保有している。

items.summary: ［３０日　ロイター］ - 格付け会社フィッチは３０日、フランスの長期発行体格付けを「Ａ＋」に据え置く一方、格付け見通し...
items.body:
仏格付け見通し「ネガティブ」に変更、フィッチ　財政悪化警告
7:15 配信

写真は7月17日、パリで撮影。REUTERS/Yara Nardi（ロイター） ［３０日　ロイター］ - 格付け会社フィッチは３０日、フランスの長期発行体格付けを「Ａ＋」に据え置く一方、格付け見通しを「安定的」から「ネガティブ」に変更した。財政状況の悪化と政治の分断が、債務の安定化に向けた見通しを損なっていると警告した。

８月の前回審査以降、成長の鈍化、借り入れコストの上昇、財政赤字の拡大が進んだと指摘。政治の分断がこれに拍車をかけ、持続的な財政健全化の実現を難しくしているとした。

フランス経済は第３・四半期に予想外のマイナス成長となった一方、１０月のインフレ率は２０２３年終盤以来の高水準に上昇した。

今回の見通し変更で、ユーロ圏第２位の経済大国であるフランスが今後格下げされるリスクが高まった。フィッチは「大統領選を前に政策論議が始まっているが、債務の安定化につながる持続的な財政赤字削減の見通しに対する当社の確信は、大きく強まってはいない」と説明した。

フィッチは現在、フランスの国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）に対する債務比率が２５年の１１５．７％から２８年には約１２４％に上昇すると見込む。一方、規模が大きく多様化した経済、強固な制度基盤、ユーロ圏加盟国であることが引き続き格付けを支えていると指摘した。

Ukraine evacuates civilians from parts of Kherson region as expiry of Oleshky ceasefire nears

The Oleshky ceasefire is the longest local pause in fighting since Russia's full-scale invasion in 2022.

FAST

Ukraine's military said it evacuated 167 people from threatened areas of southern Kherson region on Sunday (Nov 1) as a temporary local ceasefire neared expiry, two days after busloads of residents were brought out of the embattled Russian-held town of Oleshky.
A six-day local ceasefire in Oleshky and the surrounding area was reached after mediation efforts by US first lady Melania Trump and with the involvement of Pope Leo. The ceasefire was due to expire at midnight Moscow time (5am Monday, Singapore time).
It is the longest local pause in fighting since Russia's full-scale invasion in 2022.
"Units of civil-military cooperation of the 'South' group of forces, in cooperation with representatives of local authorities, evacuated 167 civilians to safer points in the Kherson region," Ukraine's General Staff wrote on Telegram.

It said the evacuees included 22 children and 21 people with limited mobility requiring special assistance.
The governor of Kherson region, Oleksandr Prokudin, urged residents to be vigilant as the expiry of the ceasefire neared.
"I also strongly urge you not to visit the so-called 'red zones' – areas and settlements near the Dnipro," Prokudin wrote on Telegram. "The intensity of Russian strikes there remains high, and the threat to life is extremely high."
In Moscow, Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov, quoted by Russian news agencies, said Russia had a positive view of how the operation was conducted in Oleshky, as well as of the coordination between the two countries' human rights commissioners.

Related:

Russia, Ukraine begin Oleshky ceasefire but keep up strikes elsewhere

The pope said he hoped cooperation between Russia and Ukraine in implementing a ceasefire in Oleshky would pave the way for broader peace efforts.
Melania Trump, writing on X, said the ceasefire "has provided residents with the freedom to move, access to food, clean water, medicine, plus a renewed sense of dignity without the constant threat of attack".
On Saturday, starved and exhausted residents of Oleshky crossed into Ukraine after a circuitous journey from the area, just a few km (miles) from the front line.
They first travelled by bus via Crimea, annexed by Russia from Ukraine in 2014, to the Russian town of Anapa, before flying to Belarus from where they continued to Ukraine.
Those wishing to leave Oleshky - some for Russia, some for Ukraine - were taken initially to Crimea in 25 buses and nine ambulances, Russian human rights commissioner Yana Lantratova said, before splitting into separate convoys.
It was not known how many chose to stay in Russian-held Oleshky, which lies on the Dnipro River opposite the region's Ukrainian-held main town of Kherson.

Vadym, a Ukrainian sergeant of the 42nd Marine Brigade walks through an area contaminated with anti-personnel mines in front of destroyed houses during an evacuation of local population to a safe area amid a local ceasefire linked to a humanitarian aid mission in Oleshky, in the village of Kozatske, Kherson region, Ukraine, Oct 31, 2026. (Photo: AP/Evgeniy Maloletka)

CEASEFIRE HOLDING The ceasefire has been holding since Tuesday without violations, according to both Ukrainian and Russian officials. It has allowed them to de-mine the roads and bring food, medicines and other supplies into the town.
Russian forces took control of the town immediately after the Feb 2022 invasion of Ukraine, but Ukrainian troops recaptured much of the region, including the town of Kherson, later that year.
Military action continued in other parts of Ukraine on Sunday.
Regional governors and emergency services reported one death in a strike in the Sumy region on the Russian border, a frequent target, and at least one in the central region of Vinnytsia.

Source: Reuters/fs

FAST

DARWIN/SYDNEY, Nov 2 : The developer of one of Australia's biggest planned data centres scrapped its target start date after a regulator said it needed longer than usual to set environmental parameters, a setback to the country's ambitions to be a fast-track destination for AI investment.
Startup Energy North, which says it has finance lined up for a sprawling gas and solar-powered data centre on a cattle ranch in the country's remote north, 683 km (424 miles) from the nearest city, had given a "first power" date of June 28, 2028, in regulatory filings four months ago.
But after the Northern Territory environment regulator said in an October 7 ruling it was suspending its seven-week deadline to decide what hurdles the project must clear, the developer told Reuters it had scrubbed its timeline.
"The June 2028 date in our referral was an indicative schedule at the time of lodgement, and we're no longer working to it," said Energy North vice president of project development Daniel Hunter in an email.

The project is the biggest in Australia to put back its timing and shows how data centre ambitions face hurdles even in the isolated north, which has sought to differentiate itself from cities in the contest for the $7 trillion McKinsey forecasts will be invested in "AI factories" globally by 2030.
The Territory is counting on luring projects with its vast supply of uninhabited land and sunshine — 260,000 residents in an area twice the size of Texas, with as much sun as the Sahara — and a huge just-opened shale gas reserve for backup power.
But stopping the clock on Energy North, the Territory's regulator said it would seek advice from the federal government, which is "developing policy expectations for data centres and AI infrastructure developers", and gave no new timeframe.
Hunter said the project was unfazed and would confirm timing once the regulator sets out terms for an environmental impact statement, required to identify and address potential adverse effects. He declined to say who is lined up to finance the project.
ISOLATED TERRITORY NOT IMMUNE TO PUSHBACK
At 1 gigawatt, Energy North's "Project Ares" is four times the size of a data centre expansion in Melbourne delayed this month by developer NextDC due to energy supply concerns and 10 times the size of a project pulled by Goodman in Sydney amid resident pushback.
"Our antiquated planning frameworks weren't designed for proposals like this," said Adam Beck, an urban planner who has written environmental impact statements for infrastructure projects and advises governments.
"Tearing up timelines is kind of standard process, but I'm not going to discount the lack of social license. There is a certain heightened level of concern by the community, and that's playing out on real projects."
In its ruling on Energy North's proposed 191 sq km (74 sq mile) data centre campus, including a gas turbine system, solar farm, airstrip and accommodation for 4,300 construction workers, the Territory's Environment Protection Agency warned of 10 impacts, from straining water systems to disrupting Aboriginal sacred sites.
It said it had a "low level of confidence in the effectiveness of proposed measures to manage potential significant impact".
Northern Territory business minister Robyn Cahill, who has said her government was talking to 12 data centre-related projects, didn't respond to requests for comment.
FEASIBILITY IN FOCUS
The gap between hope and reality isn't limited to Energy North's project. Beetaloo Energy has proposed a data centre near Darwin, twice the size of Project Ares. It would use up to 400 terajoules of gas a day, based on an estimate it gave of needing 200 terajoules per gigawatt.
That is 10 times the volume of gas flowing from the Beetaloo Basin's only producing project, Tamboran's Shenandoah South. Beetaloo Energy aims to start producing a small volume by year-end.
Just those two data centres would total 3 gigawatts, about 10 times peak demand on the entire Territory's grid. Both companies said their energy would ultimately combine renewables with their own gas-fired power, bypassing the grid. Details of the other 10 Territory projects haven't been disclosed.
Aboriginal consultation in a territory where a quarter of the population is Indigenous, meanwhile, needs travel, interpreters and repeat visits, and expediting it "does not produce prompt consent", Aboriginal group the Northern Land Council said in a submission to an ongoing federal inquiry.
The Northern Territory Cattlemen's Association expected data centre development with "effective regulation, properly enforced, that safeguards pastoral operations and the land, water and environment both industries depend on", said CEO Romy Carey.
The Territory government can override stakeholder objections but not when a complaint goes to the federal or High Court, said Rolf Gerritsen, a former policy head for the Territory chief minister's office who teaches at Charles Darwin University.
"If you've got increased opposition groups ... whatever the development proposal is, it does tend to tie it up," he said.

Source: Reuters

Iran ian negotiators were in Doha on Sunday (Nov 1) for a third consecutive day of talks with Qatari mediators aimed at pushing for a deal to end the US-Israeli war on Iran , an official briefed on the discussions told Reuters.
The talks come amid concerns that the conflict could escalate again after the Nov 3 US midterm elections. President Donald Trump has said the United States will not launch new attacks on Iran before the vote and that talks with Tehran have been productive, though he has not ruled out further military action afterwards.
Iran 's Foreign Minister Abbas Araqchi said on Sunday that the purpose of the "ongoing and progressing" talks was to continue consultations with the Qatari mediators, adding Tehran is prepared for "both defence and diplomacy".
Speaking to state media, Araqchi said discussions on a "two-day proposal" were continuing, but that no final conclusion had been reached.

Iran has repeatedly said it would respond to any new attacks by striking US and Israeli targets in neighbouring countries, as the eight-month-old war continues to disrupt global oil supplies and spill over across the Middle East.
"We are doing our best in this process, and we hope that there is rationality on the other side so that they prioritise diplomacy over other paths," Araqchi said of the talks with Qatari officials.
Iran 's Supreme Leader Ayatollah Mojtaba Khamenei on Saturday ordered the armed forces to be prepared for any attack, while the military later announced steps to strengthen its readiness.
US Secretary of State Marco Rubio said on Saturday that Trump has not decided whether to launch new strikes against Iran , but would prefer to resolve the conflict diplomatically.
Qatari mediators were in Tehran on Friday for discussions with Iran ian officials before moving the talks to Doha on Saturday, an official had told Reuters. The talks were being coordinated in regular contacts with Washington, the official added.

WASHINGTON/ANCHORAGE: US President Donald Trump returns to the campaign trail on Sunday (Nov 1) with rallies in Iowa and Kansas, Republican-leaning Farm Belt states where his party is fighting to hold US Senate seats, two days before midterm elections that will decide control of Congress .
Trump, who spent Saturday at his Mar-a-Lago estate in Florida after weeks of campaigning across multiple states, won Iowa by double digits in 2024. But polls show Democrats tied with or leading Republicans in many of the state's races. And Trump's approval among rural Americans fell to a new low of 45 percent in October, according to Reuters/Ipsos polling.
Kansas, which last elected a Democratic senator in 1932, is also facing an unexpectedly close race.
Thirty-five Senate seats and all 435 House of Representatives seats are on the ballot on Tuesday. Republicans hold narrow majorities in both chambers.

Democrats and many Republicans have framed the election as a referendum on Trump's policies.
"His agenda, without any question, is on the ballot," Senator Tim Scott, a South Carolina Republican, told NBC's "Meet the Press" on Sunday.
Scott, the head of the Republican Senate campaign committee, predicted his party would keep its majority in the chamber.
If Democrats take control of the House or Senate, they could block Trump's legislative agenda for his final two years in office and launch investigations of an administration that has so far faced largely compliant Republican majorities. The White House has been preparing to implement portions of Trump's agenda without the aid of Congress.

FRANKFURT/PEISSENBERG: German ministers threatened tough penalties for looters and rioters who damaged stores and injured more than 100 police officers in Frankfurt overnight, while praising security forces for preventing wider violence.
Frankfurt emerged as the main flashpoint on Saturday (Oct 31) after tens of thousands of people rallied in dozens of German cities to demand better education and lower living costs in protests organised by campaign group "Gen Z regelt" — "Gen Z takes charge".
In the financial hub Frankfurt, hooded rioters damaged 17 stores, of which five were looted, Roman Poseck, interior minister of the state of Hesse, told a press conference on Sunday.
He said police deployed 1,300 officers, with more than 100 injured in clashes. Police arrested 54 people aged between 13 and 29.

"I am shocked by what I have seen, and there is no point in sugar-coating it. Let me make this very clear: Things cannot go on like this," Poseck said.
Poseck said most of those arrested were German nationals, adding that many of those involved in the disturbances were of an immigrant background, citing information from the police.
"Police currently estimate that they are dealing with between 1,000 and 1,500 violent troublemakers, predominantly from an immigrant background," he added.

PROTESTERS THROW PETROL BOMBS AT POLICE Frankfurt police reported violent disturbances including windows being smashed and petrol bombs, rocks and bottles being thrown at the emergency services.
German Interior Minister Alexander Dobrindt, a member of the conservative Christian Social Union, said perpetrators would be identified and held to account.
"I expect there to be severe penalties. We are not prepared to accept, in the slightest, that such incidents and such rioting should take place here," he told reporters on Sunday.
He accused "troublemakers from the immigrant community" of acting alongside left-wing extremists and other far-left groups, but did not provide evidence to support the claim or say which groups had joined the demonstrations.
Dobrindt said a policing strategy based on a large security presence and deployments across multiple locations had proved effective.
In France, protests continued largely peacefully for a third weekend after extensive riots and looting on October 17 damaged shops, public buildings and businesses.
Dobrindt said that border controls had been tightened ahead of the protests out of fear extremist groups from abroad could exploit them to stir riots.

items.summary: The four members of a crew who took part in a simulated mission to Mars have emerged after 378 days in isolation at the US space agency's Johnson Space Center in Houston, an endeavour designed to help prepare for a possible future excursion by NASA astronauts to Earth's planetary neighbor."It's been a hell of

Crew from NASA's simulated Mars mission emerges after 378 days in isolation

This picture taken on Oct 8, 2025, shows Crew Health and Performance Exploration Analog (CHAPEA) Mission 2 crew members Ross Elder, Matthew Montgomery, Ellen Ellis, and James Spicer posing before spending more than a year in isolation at NASA's Johnson Space Center in Houston. (Photo: Retuers/NASA)

FAST

The four members of a crew who took part in a simulated mission to Mars have emerged after 378 days in isolation at the US space agency's Johnson Space Center in Houston, an endeavour designed to help prepare for a possible future excursion by NASA astronauts to Earth's planetary neighbor.
"It's been a hell of a year - analog astronauts living in captivity of our own free will," Ellen Ellis, the medical officer on the Crew Health and Performance Exploration Analog, or CHAPEA, mission, said in remarks at Johnson Space Center after emerging with her three crewmates on Saturday.
The four entered the 158 sqm 3D-printed habitat on Oct  19, 2025, and performed tasks such as growing crops in simulated Martian soil and interfacing with NASA officials with delays recreating those inherent in interplanetary communications.
NASA, which has explored Mars with robotic rovers and orbiting spacecraft, has ambitions for a human mission to Mars as early as the 2030s, with plans before that to return astronauts to the moon for the first time since 1972.

"We have a narrowing window of opportunity to maintain US preeminence in space," Ellis said.
Ellis mentioned the service academy for space-related operations pursued by President Donald Trump's administration and plans for a lunar base.
"Let's seize the initiative, lead with science that will benefit our economy and ensure our legacy in space for our children's children," Ellis said.
The other crew members were mission commander Ross Elder, science officer Matthew Montgomery and flight engineer James Spicer.
"For Mars, the risks are great," Elder said in remarks after emerging from isolation. "But through seeking understanding, strong vision and leadership, creativity, fortitude, hard work and incredible foundation, the goal of putting humans on Mars is not only achievable, but rather inevitable."
The crew is set to participate in two weeks of post-mission evaluations and debriefing with NASA scientists. NASA has said it is looking for insight into what it takes for astronauts to adapt to the routines and demands of daily life on long-duration missions beyond Earth to keep them healthy, productive, and connected.
This was NASA's second CHAPEA mission, with another four-person crew in isolation at Johnson Space Center for 378 days spanning 2023 and 2024.
Vanessa Wyche, director of the Johnson Space Center, greeted the crew members when they exited isolation. Wyche said they managed to live with limited resources, maintain their habitat, and carry out simulated Mars operations. 
Wyche also noted how the crew dealt with the simulated interplanetary communications, with lag times between sending messages and receiving responses.
"These delays require patience, careful planning and greater independence - qualities that will be essential for future astronauts traveling millions of miles from home," Wyche said.
Wyche said the lessons learned from the CHAPEA crew and their experiences will help pave the way for the missions first to the moon and "one day, Mars".

Source: Reuters/nh

items.title: Republican Midterm Redistricting Now Looks Like a Blunder
items.author: Mary Ellen Klas
items.creator: Mary Ellen Klas
items.summary: President Donald Trump’s mid-decade redistricting war is shaping up to be a strategic blunder. At the president’s urging, Republicans gerrymandered new maps based on Trump’s 2024 performance, wrongly assuming the midterm electorate would match his presidential coalition. Now, once-durable Republican strongholds that were redrawn for partisan gain have become fragile, forcing Republicans to direct resources to districts they thought would be solidly red.

FAST

LONDON/MOSCOW, Nov 1 : OPEC+ oil-producing countries kept December production targets steady on Sunday, confirming expectations that more policy adjustments will not occur until next year, as the group continues to struggle with export disruptions from the Iran war.
Seven core OPEC+ members — Saudi Arabia, Russia, Iraq, Kuwait, Algeria, Kazakhstan and Oman — made the decision in an online meeting on Sunday, OPEC said in a statement. While Gulf members have been boosting exports that have been disrupted for months by the conflict, most are still pumping well below their targets.
OPEC+ comprises the Organization of the Petroleum Exporting Countries and allies including Russia. Only the seven members — plus the United Arab Emirates until it quit OPEC in May — have been involved in monthly output decisions in recent years. All members of the 21-country group are due to meet on November 29, when analysts expect it will decide 2027 quotas.
"Today's decision was the easy one," said Jorge Leon, an analyst at Rystad. "The much more important test comes at the November 29 ministerial meeting, when OPEC+ will decide its 2027 production framework."

Oil prices jumped more than 2 per cent on Friday, with Brent crude settling at almost $118 a barrel, the highest since April, as traders braced for a potential escalation in the Iran war after the US midterm elections.
The International Energy Agency and other forecasters have warned of excess supply in 2027 should Gulf flows return to normal.
"OPEC+ faces an extremely difficult call for 2027," Leon added. "The group has to plan around huge uncertainty over the US-Iran war, the pace of recovery through the Strait of Hormuz, and the size of the surplus that could emerge once disrupted barrels return."
OIL CAPACITY REVIEW IN FOCUS
The seven members have been boosting output targets for much of 2026 and in September completed the phased rollback of a 1.65 million-barrel-per-day supply cut first agreed in 2023. At earlier meetings, they kept the targets steady for October and November.
OPEC+ still has one more layer of production cuts of about 2 million bpd covering most members through the end of 2026.
The group needs to complete a review of members' production capacity during the fourth quarter before setting the 2027 baselines that will determine future quotas and shape plans to unwind those cuts, sources have said.
The Iran war has disrupted projects to expand capacity across the Middle East, throwing estimates of future production potential into uncertainty, Reuters reported in October. As a result, the review is now expected to be completed by mid-November.

items.title: バイナンスが出金再開、顧客引き出し36億ドル超　被害の95％補填
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［１日　ロイター］ -  世界最大の暗号資産（仮想通貨）交換所バイナンスは１日、ビットコイン、イーサ、一部のステーブルコ...
items.body:
バイナンスが出金再開、顧客引き出し36億ドル超　被害の95％補填
11/1 10:55 配信

写真はバイナンスのロゴとコードのイメージ。10月30日撮影。REUTERS/Dado Ruvic（ロイター） ［１日　ロイター］ -  世界最大の暗号資産（仮想通貨）交換所バイナンスは１日、ビットコイン、イーサ、一部のステーブルコインの出金を再開した。再開後の顧客による純流出額は、同社が管理する資産の２．１％に当たる３６億４０００万ドルに上っている。

バイナンスは、出金は当初の急増後に落ち着きつつあり、入金額も「相当な水準」を維持していると説明。同社のプラットフォームから盗まれた６３億ドル相当の資産のうち、これまでに９５％を補塡したとしている。

出金の規模は、攻撃後も顧客が資金の預け先としてバイナンスを信頼しているかどうかを測る最初の試金石となる。

バイナンスによると、純流出額は１５３０ＧＭＴ（日本時間２日午前０時３０分）時点の顧客の出金と入金を反映したもの。

一方、暗号資産分析プラットフォームのディーファイラマは、流出額はこれより多い４３億６０００万ドルだとした。

バイナンスの広報担当者はディーファイラマのデータについて「この数字には、当社が自社の新しいホットウォレットに入金した資金の移動が含まれておらず、正確ではない。当社のＸでの最新の更新情報が最も正確な数字に近い（投稿後の入出金の動きは除く）」と述べた。

出金再開は利用者の需要を踏まえて段階的に行う。第１段階はビットコイン、イーサ、ＸＲＰ、ドージコインなど１５の暗号資産が対象。ビットコインの出金は０６００ＧＭＴ（日本時間午後３時）過ぎに再開した。イーサとＢＮＢのほか、ステーブルコインのＵＳＤＴとＵＳＤＣの一部も出金できるようになった。

バイナンスはＸへの投稿で「過去１週間の利用者の需要データに基づいてトークンの優先順位を決め、段階的に対応している」とした。

同社はこれに先立ち、自社の資金で代わりのトークンを購入し、盗まれた暗号資産のうち６０億ドル分を補塡したと説明した。残りの５％は流動性が比較的低い資産のため、必要な量の調達に時間がかかる可能性があるという。

代わりのトークンの購入資金について、セキュリティーが破られた場合に顧客を守るため保有するビットコインの準備金「ユーザー向け安全資産ファンド（ＳＡＦＵ）」（１０億ドル）のほか、先物保険基金の一部と自社の財務資金も充てたと説明した。

米連邦捜査局（ＦＢＩ）は１０月３１日、今回のバイナンスへの攻撃が、北朝鮮の国家支援組織「トレーダー・トレイター」によるものだと発表。声明で、同組織の構成員が流出資産をイーサリアムに交換する様子が確認されたとし、関連技術を用いた資産の「さらなる資金洗浄」が行われるとみていると述べた。

トランプ米大統領は１０月３１日、バイナンスの事案について、北朝鮮が関与したかどうか米国はまだ確信を持てていないと述べた。

ホワイトハウスがＸのアカウントに投稿した映像によると、トランプ氏は、記者団に対し「北朝鮮かどうかは分からない。だが、もしそうなら、北朝鮮とこの件について話をする」と語った。

SEOUL, Nov 1 : South Korea's exports nearly doubled in October from a year earlier, beating market expectations and marking the sharpest jump in more than 50 years, trade data showed on Sunday.
Exports from Asia's fourth-largest economy, a bellwether for global trade, rose 93.7 per cent last month to $115.28 billion, slightly higher than a median 93.2 per cent rise forecast in a Reuters poll of economists.
The increase, boosted by favourable calendar effects of more working days due to the timing difference in local Chuseok holidays, beat September's 83.7 per cent gain and was the strongest since January 1974.
Overseas sales of semiconductors jumped 259.4 per cent as prices and volume remained high on continued facility investment by global big tech firms in the competition for artificial intelligence industry leadership, the trade ministry said.

Binance, the world's biggest cryptocurrency exchange, resumed bitcoin, ether and some stablecoin withdrawals on Sunday (Nov 1) and said others would follow in phases, after it covered 95 per cent of the US$6.3 billion in tokens stolen from its platform.
The heist, which the FBI has tied to North Korea and analysts believe may be the biggest financial robbery ever, adds to a string of recent crypto thefts. Last year, attackers stole US$2.9 billion worth of cryptocurrency across nearly 150 attacks, according to researchers at TRM Labs.
Binance, which was founded in China, said the first phase of withdrawals would cover 15 crypto assets including bitcoin, ether, XRP and dogecoin. Bitcoin withdrawals resumed shortly after 0600 GMT, while ether, BNB and some USDT and USDC stablecoin withdrawals were also restored.
Binance said it had covered US$6 billion of stolen cryptocurrencies by using company money to buy replacement tokens. The remaining 5 per cent of stolen tokens consist of assets that are less liquid and may take longer to source in the required amounts, according to the exchange.
FBI TIES ATTACK TO NORTH KOREAN UNIT

The FBI said on Saturday that the North Korean state-sponsored unit known as TraderTraitor was responsible for the attack.
Pyongyang has for years denied using state-linked cyber units for espionage, financial theft and revenue. Its mission in Geneva and embassy in China did not respond to requests for comment.
Law enforcement observed members of the unit converting stolen assets into the cryptocurrency ether, the FBI said in a statement, adding that it expected "further laundering" of the assets through the use of related technology.
Analysts had also blamed North Korea for the heist.
The bulk of the theft unfolded in around 20 minutes beginning late on Thursday and bore similarities to previous large attacks blamed on North Korea, according to US blockchain analysis firms TRM Labs and Chainalysis.
US President Donald Trump, however, said on Saturday that the United States was still not certain if North Korea was involved.
"We don't know if it's North Korea - but if it is, we'll talk to North Korea about it," Trump told reporters on Saturday in comments posted by a White House account on X.

Related:

Gone in 20 minutes: How the biggest heist in crypto history unfolded

BINANCE VOWS TO BEAR FINANCIAL COSTS Binance has been working with industry partners to freeze some of the affected assets, with about US$3 billion located as of Friday, it said.
The exchange has repeatedly said it would bear the financial impact of the funds stolen in the hack. It has set aside around US$6.34 billion of company funds internally to cover the losses.
The money spent buying replacement tokens came from Binance's US$1 billion Secure Asset Fund for Users (SAFU), a bitcoin reserve it holds to protect customers in the event of security breaches, as well as some of its Futures Insurance Fund and its corporate treasury, it said on X.
Co-CEO Yi He said on Saturday that 50 per cent of its SAFU funds would be used, while the company committed to replenishing the fund to about US$1 billion.
Richard Teng, the other co-CEO, has said that the breach was a "complex attack" involving a compromised laptop and malicious software designed to delete evidence of its activity, making it harder to trace and investigate.
Crypto prices fell on Friday, while Binance sought to reassure customers that their funds were safe after the hack.
Binance, which allows users to buy, sell and trade digital assets, has 335 million registered users globally and had about US$162.8 billion in assets under custody as of its 2025 annual report.
BINANCE FOUNDER CZ THANKS US LAW ENFORCEMENT In a post on X that quoted the FBI statement on North Korea’s involvement, Binance thanked the agency for its support. It did not respond to a request for comment on North Korea's involvement.
Binance founder Changpeng Zhao, who was convicted in the US of failing to maintain an effective anti-money laundering program before being pardoned by Trump last year, said US law enforcement agencies provided vital help, including by tracking and freezing the stolen assets.
"A tweet can't fully express our gratitude. Many crypto bros may not realize, a lot of the 'why bitcoin didn't drop more?' credit goes to them," Zhao wrote, referring to the US law enforcement agencies.

Related:

Hackers allegedly from North Korea steal US$6.3 billion from Binance in world's biggest crypto heist

FAST

Oct 31 : Crypto exchange Binance said on Saturday it has been able to replace 90 per cent of the amount stolen after a record $6.3 billion hack of its platform by using company money to buy new tokens.
The remaining 10 per cent consists of tokens that are less liquid, meaning they may take longer to buy, it said in a statement posted on X.
"We've now replenished 90 per cent of the stolen assets, and we're committed to covering the remaining 10 per cent. Our users will not bear the financial impact of this incident," co-CEO Richard Teng said on X on Saturday. 
Crypto prices fell on Friday, while Binance — the world's biggest crypto exchange — sought to reassure customers that their funds were safe after losing more than $6 billion worth of crypto in a hack that analysts and the FBI blamed on North Korea.

The FBI on Saturday said the North Korean state-sponsored unit known as TraderTraitor was responsible for the attack. Members of the unit were observed by law enforcement converting stolen assets into the cryptocurrency ethereum, the FBI said in a statement, adding that it expects "further laundering" of the assets through the use of related technology. 
Teng said on Friday that the breach was a "complex attack" involving a compromised laptop and malicious software designed to delete evidence of its activity, making it harder to trace and investigate.
After the hack, the exchange stopped allowing customers to withdraw their funds, but it said on Saturday it was still on track to reopen withdrawals on Sunday.
Binance said it has set aside around $6.34 billion of company funds internally to cover the losses. 
The money spent re-buying tokens came from using part of its $1 billion Secure Asset Fund for Users (SAFU), a bitcoin reserve it holds to protect customers in the event of security breaches, as well as some of its Futures Insurance Fund, and the company's own corporate treasury, it said on X.
Binance also said it had taken a new snapshot of assets held on its platform as of 0000 GMT on October 31, as part of its proof-of-reserves process.
Users holding the 10 listed tokens — BTC, ETH, USDT, BNB, SOL, USDC, XRP, USD1, RLUSD, and ZEC — would be able to verify that their assets were backed at a minimum ratio of 1:1 once the full proof was available, it said.

Source: Reuters

NEW YORK, Oct 31 : US electricity prices had flown under the radar in past national elections, but they have become a major political issue in this year's midterms as Americans grow angry over rising utility bills and deals for power-hungry data centers.
Nationwide, according to Energy Information Administration data, electricity prices for homes have risen more than 10 per cent since 2024 when President Donald Trump was elected along with Republican majorities in both houses of the US Congress. Higher electricity prices have outpaced the rise in costs for other goods and services.
Power bills have grown even faster in political battleground states of Ohio, Michigan and Pennsylvania, which are also hot spots for new data centers. In some cases, electricity bills have soared by triple the inflation rate. 
Many politicians vying for top statehouse seats across the country this year have backed cracking down on utilities. Some have proposed freezing utility rate increases and slashing guaranteed returns, steps that could have sweeping consequences for the country's utility industry.

"It could be the first election to feature utilities and electricity, specifically, as a prominent issue in the midterms," said Charles Hua, executive director of PowerLines, a nonprofit that advocates reforming utility policy to favor consumers. "Part of that is because people's utility bills have gone up and up, and they don't see any end in sight." 
Utilities are heavily regulated. State regulators generally must approve utilities’ requests to spend on the grid and to recover those costs through rate increases. Regulators also set the return on equity utilities can earn on their grid investments. 
This year, utilities are on track to match last year's record high $31 billion in rate increase requests to regulators, a PowerLines survey showed.  Last year's spending was double the previous record.
The investor-owned companies are also expected to carry out a record of nearly $1.3 trillion in capital spending over the next five years, according to an analysis by S&P Global’s Regulatory Research Associates.
UTILITIES SPOTLIGHTED
Seats on nine state public utility commissions are up for election this year, nearly all the US states where voters elect their utility regulators. These include burgeoning data center hubs Arizona and Georgia.
Governors will be chosen in 36 US states this year, and governors appoint utility regulators in states where commissioners are not directly elected. 
In Ohio, Democrat Amy Acton has promised to lower energy bills if she is elected governor. Her campaign said she will also appoint a public utilities commission that was "not beholden to utility companies" and work with the state attorney general to crack down on "excessive rate hikes and predatory practices."
Ohio's residential electricity bills have grown by more than 20 per cent over the last two years, according to EIA data.
Acton has also said she supports a data center moratorium. Her Republican opponent Vivek Ramaswamy said he would assure Ohioans living near data centers would not pay electricity bills at all.
BULLY PULPIT
Some governors who are up for reelection have used their political weight to pressure the power industry to keep prices down.
In April, Pennsylvania Governor Josh Shapiro announced that prominent utility, PECO Energy Company, had acceded to his demand that it withdraw its proposal with state regulators to increase rates. Shapiro, a Democrat running for reelection, said the move would reduce future utility bills by as much as $34 a month.
He followed up with a letter to more utility CEOs seeking changes in how utilities justify spending and returns on equity.
"The governors are using this crisis on energy affordability as an opportunity to take a deeper dive into the utility regulatory model and see if it makes any sense," said Jamie Van Nostrand, senior fellow at the Kleinman Center for Energy Policy at the University of Pennsylvania and former chair of the Massachusetts Department of Public Utilities. 
Power bills tracked low inflation for roughly a decade, and were not an issue in most mainstream elections until last year, when Mikie Sherrill successfully ran for New Jersey governor on the promise of freezing utility bills. She did so the same day she took office.
In Virginia, home to the largest concentration of data centers in the world, Governor Abigail Spanberger took a similar approach, which industry analysts said could offer a playbook for those who win this year’s elections. 
Utility advocates say reducing guaranteed returns and freezing rates will not make a meaningful difference in household bills but could lead to a long-term reduction of investments in the grid.
"The grid is America's greatest machine, and it doesn't operate on the political calendar,” said Drew Maloney, president of Edison Electric Institute, a trade organization for investor-owned electric utilities. “It requires consistent investment every year to deliver reliable energy to our customers."
Credit rating agency Fitch downgraded the North American utility sector to "deteriorating" from "neutral" in June, citing political pressure in the midterms to limit electricity bills and utility profits.
For an industry that plans in decades, it is hard to predict the result of short-term political moves aimed at saving money for households.
"I do think the real meat will come after the election," Hua said.

Source: Reuters

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [北京 ３１日 ロイター] - 中国国家統計局が３１日発表した１０月の製造業購買担当者景気指数（ＰＭＩ）は４９．３に低下...
items.body:
中国製造業ＰＭＩ、10月は49.3　4カ月で3度目の縮小
10/31 12:54 配信

写真は中国広東省東莞市にある工場倉庫で３月撮影。 REUTERS/Tingshu Wang（ロイター） [北京 ３１日 ロイター] - 中国国家統計局が３１日発表した１０月の製造業購買担当者景気指数（ＰＭＩ）は４９．３に低下し、景気拡大と縮小の分岐点となる５０を下回った。製造業活動が縮小したのは過去４カ月で３度目。国内の財需要の低迷と輸出の弱まりの兆しが重しとなった。

ロイターがまとめた市場予想の５０．０を下回った。９月は５０．１だった。

製造業活動が弱まったのは、９月に前倒しされていた海外からのクリスマス関連受注が１０月になって落ち着いたため。国慶節の大型連休中に増加した個人消費も、連休明けには勢いを失い、長期の低迷状態に戻ったことが響いた。

中国物流購買連合会のアナリスト張立群氏は「需要不足が景気への下押し圧力を強めている」と指摘。政策当局はこの問題を深刻に受け止め、できるだけ早く対策を強化すべきだと述べた。

新規受注指数と新規輸出受注指数はいずれも縮小圏にとどまった。生産と購買活動も拡大から縮小に転じた。

ピンポイント・アセット・マネジメントのチーフエコノミスト張智威氏は、２０２７年に外需が弱まれば「中国は内需を押し上げるため、より大規模な政策支援が必要になる」と述べた。

東呉証券のチーフエコノミスト、ルー・ジャー氏は「家計の信頼感を支え、心理を安定させるため」、住宅ローン利払いへの補助拡充が必要だとした。また、利払いへの補助を投資事業にも広げれば、採算の見込める固定資産投資案件が不足している現状の緩和につながるとの見方を示した。

サービス業と建設業を対象とする非製造業ＰＭＩも４９．７と、９月の５０．２から低下した。

ＰＭＩは、新規受注や生産、雇用などの状況が前月と比べて改善したか、悪化したか、変わらなかったかについて、購買担当者の回答を基に算出する。５０を上回ると活動の拡大、下回ると縮小を示す。

製造業の一部業種は好調だった。鉄道、造船、航空宇宙機器やコンピューター・通信・電子機器の製造業では、生産指数と新規受注指数がいずれも５３．０以上となった。

特に人工知能（ＡＩ）関連企業は大幅な増益を報告している。ＡＩデータセンターでサーバーとスイッチを接続する高速光モジュールを製造する中際旭創（ジョンジー・イノライト）は、第３・四半期の純利益が約３倍となった。

一方、国内市場の低迷とコスト上昇は、多くの従来型の製造業や不動産関連企業の重しとなっている。オーダーメード家具メーカーの欧派家居（オッペイン・ホーム）は、同期の純利益が８０％減少した。

ただ、中国経済は第３・四半期の成長率が４．５％と、４─６月期の４．３％から持ち直したことから、追加の景気刺激策なしでも年間４．５─５．０％の成長目標を達成する見通しだ。

items.author: ロイター

items.summary: [３０日 ロイター] - 英紙フィナンシャル・タイムズ（ＦＴ）は３０日、米人工知能（ＡＩ）開発企業オープンＡＩが最新の...
items.body:
オープンＡＩ、資金調達目標を100億ドル引き下げ＝ＦＴ
10/31 10:23 配信

写真はオープンＡＩのロゴ。６月撮影。 REUTERS/Dado Ruvic（ロイター） [３０日 ロイター] - 英紙フィナンシャル・タイムズ（ＦＴ）は３０日、米人工知能（ＡＩ）開発企業オープンＡＩが最新の資金調達ラウンドの目標額を１００億ドル引き下げ、企業評価額１兆２５００億ドルで２００億ドルの調達を目指していると報じた。事情に詳しい関係者の話として伝えた。

対話型ＡＩ「チャットＧＰＴ」を手がける同社は当初、企業評価額１兆４０００億ドルで３００億ドルを調達する計画だった。ロイターは先週、競合するアンソロピックが１１月中旬に予定する株式上場を前に、オープンＡＩが投資家の出資取り付けを急いでいると報じていた。

ＦＴによると、オープンＡＩは投資家が出資を確約する期限を３０日に設定した。ただ、一部の投資家が出資額を減らしたため、第１段階の調達額は２００億ドルを下回る見通しだという。

オープンＡＩからコメントは得られていない。

ＡＩへの巨額支出に対する懸念の高まりを受け、３０日の米国株式市場では米ハイテク株が急落。ナスダック総合指数は２．９％安となり、１０月６日に付けた終値ベースの最高値から７．８％下落している。

items.title: トランプ氏「北朝鮮の関与調査」、バイナンスの暗号資産流出巡り
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Lawrence Delevingne　Summer Zhen　Elizabeth Howcroft

[ボストン／シン...
items.body:
トランプ氏「北朝鮮の関与調査」、バイナンスの暗号資産流出巡り
10/31 9:10 配信

写真はフロリダ州デイトナビーチへ向かうため「マリン・ワン」に乗り込む前に報道陣に手を振るトランプ米大統領。REUTERS/Umit Bektas（ロイター） Lawrence Delevingne　Summer Zhen　Elizabeth Howcroft

[ボストン／シンガポール／パリ ３０日 ロイター] - 世界最大の暗号資産（仮想通貨）交換業者バイナンスがサイバー攻撃を受けて６３億ドル相当の資産が流出した事件で、トランプ米大統領は３０日、北朝鮮のハッカーが関与したかは分からないとした上で、政権として調査していると述べた。

アナリストは北朝鮮が事件に関与していると分析しており、金融資産の窃盗事件として史上最大となる可能性を指摘した。

トランプ氏は、盗まれた資金を一部でも回収できると思うかと記者団に問われ、「ハッキングだった。それが問題だ。昔は小切手に署名してお金を引き出したものだが、これは違う」と指摘。一方、「ただ、バイナンスは状況をほぼ掌握していると言っている」と述べた。

関係者によると、バイナンスは米連邦捜査局（ＦＢＩ）や米シークレットサービス（ＵＳＳＳ）に協力している。

ＦＢＩは「事件を認識しており、活動の範囲を把握し、潜在的な影響を評価し、適切な捜査手続きを調整するため、関係する官民の協力先と連携している」と表明した。

ＵＳＳＳは、捜査関係者が「民間の協力企業と２４時間態勢で連携し、２９日にバイナンスから盗まれた資金の特定、凍結、追跡、回収に取り組んでいる」と説明した。

ステーブルコイン発行会社テザーは、事件に関連する約１５億７０００万ドルの資産を凍結したと発表。サークルは８億ドル超を凍結した。

バイナンスに主要な営業免許を交付したアブダビ金融サービス規制庁は「バイナンスと緊密に連携し、事件を注視している」と表明した。

items.body:
ＮＹ市場サマリー（30日）円3日続伸、株急落　利回り低下
10/31 6:14 配信

＜為替＞　円が３日続伸。日銀が政策金利を据え置き、物価見通しを引き上げたことが材料となったほか、米国債利回りの低下もドルの重しとなった。 

日銀は３０日、金融政策決定会合で金利の据え置きを決定した。ただ、金融政策はよりタカ派的な新たな局面に入ったと強調し、数カ月に１度のペースでの利上げに踏み切る可能性を示唆した。 

円は対ドルで０．１１％高の１ドル＝１５７．５１円。ただ、月間では下落する見通しとなった。

主要通貨に対するドル指数は横ばいの１０１．８８。月間では２カ月続伸となる見通し。 

ユーロは０．１２％安の１．１１６８ドル。月間では２カ月続落となる見通し。

来週はイングランド銀行（英中央銀行）とオーストラリア準備銀行（中央銀行）の金融政策決定会合が注目される。 

英ポンドは０．１５％高の１．３３９６ドル。豪ドルは対米ドルで０．０９％高の０．７０３４５米ドル。いずれも月間ベースで上昇する勢いとなっている。

暗号資産（仮想通貨）のビットコインは２．６１％安の７万６７８０．９３ドル。世界最大の暗号資産（仮想通貨）交換業者バイナンスで、ハッカーの攻撃により６３億ドル相当の資産が流出したことが材料視された。 

ＮＹ外為市場：[USD/J]

＜債券＞　指標となる１０年債利回りの１０月月間の低下幅が３６ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）となり、２３年１２月以来の大きさとなった。週間でも４週連続で低下し、連続低下期間は１年ぶりの長さとなった。

ハイテク関連株の急落で人工知能（ＡＩ）投資への懸念が強まり、安全資産である米国債に資金が流入した。

米１０年債利回りは終盤で６．４ｂｐ低下の４．９２５％。一時は９月半ば以来の低水準を付けた。３０年債利回りは１．９ｂｐ低下の５．３１％で、月間低下幅は同じく２３年１２月以来の大きさとなる見通し。

ＦＲＢの政策金利見通しを反映しやすい２年債利回りは８．１ｂｐ低下の４．５７５％。月間では２０２５年８月以来の大幅低下となる見通し。

経済見通しを示す指標として注目される２年債と１０年債の利回り格差は３４．６ｂｐだった。

物価連動国債（ＴＩＰＳ）と通常の国債の利回り差で、期待インフレを示すブレーク・イーブン・インフレ率（ＢＥＩ）は、５年物が２．４６１％。２９日終盤は２．４６９％だった。１０年物ＴＩＰＳのＢＥＩは２．３３６％だった。 

米金融・債券市場：[US/BJ]

＜株式＞　急落して取引を終えた。ナスダック総合は１日の下落率として６月５日以来の大きさを記録した。２９日に発表されたインテルとアマゾン・ドット・コムの四半期決算が期待外れとなり、人工知能（ＡＩ）関連企業による巨額支出を巡る懸念が一段と強まった。

主要３指数はいずれも大幅に下落。ハイテク株の比率が高いナスダックは２．９％安となった 。

アマゾンは取引が進むにつれて下げ幅を縮めたが、インテル株は２８．６％急落した。 

半導体株は大きく値を下げた。エヌビディアが４．２％安、ＡＭＤが１０．９％安となった。フィラデルフィア半導体指数は７．２％下落し、月間で１５％を超える下げとなった。

サーバー大手のデルとＨＰはそれぞれ１０．８％安、９．６％安だった。 

主要３指数はいずれも週間で下落して取引を終えた。Ｓ＆Ｐ５００とナスダックは月間でも下落したが、ダウは上昇して１０月を終えた。

第３・四半期の決算発表シーズンは折り返し点を過ぎ、Ｓ＆Ｐ５００構成企業のうち２９９社が発表を終えた。ＬＳＥＧのデータによると、このうち８２％が市場予想を上回った。アナリストは現在、Ｓ＆Ｐ５００構成企業の第３・四半期利益が前年同期比３１．６％増加すると予想している。

石油大手エクソンモービルとシェブロンは、ともに四半期利益が市場予想を上回った。エネルギー供給の混乱で利益率が急上昇したことが寄与した。両社株はそれぞれ２．２％高、２．８％高となった。 

コーヒーチェーンのスターバックスは１．８％安。中国事業の売却に伴い、通期売上高が減少するとの見通しを示した。

暗号資産（仮想通貨）関連企業のコインベース、ストラテジー、ロビンフッドは７．２─１０．６％下落した。 世界最大の暗号資産（仮想通貨）交換業者バイナンスで、ハッカーの攻撃により６３億ドル相当の資産が流出したことを受けた。

ニューヨーク証券取引所（ＮＹＳＥ）では値下がり銘柄数が値上がり銘柄数を１．８対１の比率で上回った。ナスダックでは値下がり銘柄数が値上がり銘柄数を３．０３対１の比率で上回った。

米取引所の出来高は１９８億７０００万株で、直近２０営業日の平均１７２億６０００万株を上回った。

米国株式市場：[.NJP]

＜金先物＞　金価格は１年ぶりの安値を付けた。銀、プラチナ、パラジウムも大幅に下落し、テクニカル指標で売られ過ぎの水準に沈んだ。米東部時間午後２時１３分（日本時間３１日午前３時１３分）時点で、金現物は３．５％安の１オンス＝３８８０．９７ドルとなり、２０２５年１０月以来の安値を記録。銀は６．５％安の４９ドルと、１１カ月ぶりに５０ドルを割り込んだ。パラジウムも１０００ドルを下回った。米金先物１２月物の清算値は３．３％安の１オンス＝３８９８．９０ドルだった。

ＮＹ貴金属：[GOL/XJ]

＜米原油先物＞　２％超急騰し、４月末以来の高値で取引を終えた。来週に控える米中間選挙後に、イランとの戦争がさらに激化する可能性に市場が身構える中、ホルムズ海峡でのタンカー攻撃が供給リスクを浮き彫りにした。     清算値は、北海ブレント先物１２月限は２．７６ドル（２．４％）高の１バレル＝１１７．６４ドル。一時、１１８ドルの高値を付けた。１月限は２．６３ドル高の１１３．４３ドル。    米ＷＴＩ先物は２．１２ドル（２．０８％）高の１０４．１２ドル。     月間ではブレントが１３．６％、ＷＴＩが１５．２％それぞれ上昇した。    英国海軍の海事機関（ＵＫＭＴＯ） によると、３０日にホルムズ海峡で、小型船によって取り付けられた爆発物によってタンカーが攻撃された。攻撃の詳細については、直ちには明らかになっていない。  

ＮＹＭＥＸエネルギー：[CR/USJ]

SpaceX Relies on Anthropic for a Third of Its Revenue Less than 1 min read

SPCX ANT
SpaceX's SPCX largest customer is Anthropic, which accounted for 34.5% of the company's third-quarter revenue, Bloomberg reported, citing a person familiar with the matter. SpaceX shares were down 4.01% as of 10:00 a.m. ET.
SpaceX's quarterly filing identifies the buyer only as Customer B, whose revenue sits in the Super Intelligence segment, the AI computing unit that generated $7.56 billion of SpaceX's $14.58 billion in third-quarter revenue. Anthropic's payments have overtaken those from the U.S. federal government, previously SpaceX's largest customer, Bloomberg reported.
Anthropic has agreed to spend as much as $120.5 billion under computing contracts with SpaceX through 2029, about $3.1 billion a month starting in December, according to Bloomberg, citing Anthropic's IPO disclosures. The agreements allow Anthropic to terminate them with 90 days' notice from early 2027, the report said.

items.title: Gold price slumps to one-year low, silver price breaks $50 as mining stocks tank
items.author: Frik Els
items.creator: Frik Els
items.summary: Bullion is headed for its worst October since 2008, dragging down gold and silver producers as much as 8% on Friday.
items.body:
Gold price slumps to one-year low, silver price breaks $50 as mining stocks tank

Staff Writer | October 30, 2026 | 9:31 am
Iran War   Markets   Canada   Middle East   USA   Gold   Silver  

Edited stock image.

Gold fell to its lowest in a year on Friday and silver dropped below $50 an ounce as rising oil prices hardened bets on another Federal Reserve rate hike and a deepening rout in technology stocks forced investors to sell the metals to cover losses elsewhere, dragging gold and silver producers down as much as 8%.

Spot gold fell as much as 3.2% to $3,891.67 an ounce, its weakest since Oct. 28 last year, and was trading down 2.7% at $3,910.53 by late morning in New York. Comex gold for December delivery dropped 3.1% to $3,907.90 an ounce after touching $3,900.90, a week after sliding below $4,000 for the first time since July .

Click on chart for live prices.

Silver fared worse, sliding 5.8% to $49.34 an ounce, its first time under $50 since November 2025, and is down roughly 18% for the month. The metal has now given back everything it gained since early December, when it began the two-month run that carried it above $120. Comex silver for December delivery fell as much as 6.3% to $49.08 an ounce and was last down 5.9% at $49.31.

Click on chart for live prices.

Volumes were heavy for this point in the session, with futures covering a nominal 18 million ounces of gold and 236 million ounces of silver changing hands on the Comex by midday in New York.

Gold is on track for a drop of about 6% in October, its worst showing for the month since 2008, when the global financial crisis was upending markets, and a second straight monthly decline. Bullion now trades about 28% below the record close of $5,419.83 it set on January 28.

The selling came from two directions. The prospect of renewed US military action against Iran, including an attack on a tanker in the Strait of Hormuz, pushed Brent crude to its highest since April and oil toward a fourth straight monthly gain, reinforcing the inflation worries that prompted the Fed in September to raise rates for the first time since July 2023. The Fed and the European Central Bank both held this week but pointed to inflation risks from surging energy costs, and data on Thursday showed US inflation accelerated in September; traders now price a more than 70% chance of a Fed hike in December.

“The indication was that the higher-for-longer theme prevails,” Peter Grant, senior metals strategist at Zaner Metals, told Reuters, adding that inflation worries have multiple central banks continuing to tilt hawkish.

At the same time, technology shares led global stocks lower for a second day as another round of disappointing earnings accelerated a rotation out of the artificial intelligence trade and into Treasuries, with the Nasdaq set for steep losses on worries about AI spending.

“Gold is getting caught up in the momentum,” said Bart Melek, global head of commodity strategy at TD Securities, who told Bloomberg that higher oil is triggering a risk-off bid for Treasuries that drains liquidity from equities and bullion alike. Trend followers are now testing long-term support in both metals, he added.

Analysts at Commerzbank said the fall in tech stocks may have prompted margin calls and forced selling, but called the decline in precious metals exaggerated and still expect a recovery.

Physical buyers are not stepping in yet. Demand in India remained subdued this week as buyers held off in anticipation of lower prices, Reuters reported, and demand in top consumer China stayed muted, even as Asian investors have been picking up gold-backed funds that North American investors are dumping.

Silver’s slide has pushed the gold-silver ratio to its highest since December. Ole Hansen, head of commodity strategy at Saxo Bank, said the divergence underscores silver’s vulnerability relative to gold, and that further liquidation by technically driven funds could open the door to the mid-$40s. Platinum dropped 4% to its lowest since September 2025 and palladium fell 3.1% to a June 2025 low.

Miners: almost $140 billion gone from the top five

Gold and silver producers fell further than the metals themselves on Friday, extending a slide that has left most of the sector a third or more below the highs set earlier this year and that knocked $264 billion off the world’s 50 largest miners in the third quarter.

Newmont, the world’s largest gold miner, dropped 5% by late morning in New York, cutting its market value to $110 billion and leaving the stock more than 20% below its 52-week high. Agnico Eagle Mines lost 6.7% to a $83 billion valuation and Barrick Mining fell 5% to $60 billion, with both now roughly a third off their peaks and Barrick down almost 16% for the year. Wheaton Precious Metals, the largest of the streaming companies, lost 5.1% and trades 30% below its high, while Franco-Nevada, down 2.2%, held up best of the group and sits 21% off its peak.

Kinross Gold was the worst of the majors, sliding 7.7% to the edge of its 52-week low. The Toronto-based company has shed 17% in October alone, has lost half its value from its high and is now worth $23 billion. Alamos Gold, down 5.2% a day after delaying a shaft at its Island Gold mine as costs rise , is also trading at a 52-week low and roughly half its peak, while Harmony Gold fell 7%, Gold Fields 6% and AngloGold Ashanti 5.8%, all three now about 40% below their highs. Eldorado Gold lost 4%, adding to Thursday’s drop on an 18% cut to its gold outlook .

Together, Newmont, Agnico, Barrick, Wheaton and Franco-Nevada, North America’s five most valuable gold companies, have lost almost $140 billion in combined market value from their 52-week highs, with Agnico alone accounting for more than $40 billion of that.

Silver producers have been hit hardest. Hecla Mining fell 6% on Friday and has lost 60% from its 52-week high, taking its market capitalization down to $9 billion. Coeur Mining dropped 6.2% to a $13.5 billion valuation, down 25% in October and 53% from its peak, and First Majestic Silver, down 6%, has lost more than half its value from its high. Pan American Silver fell 6.3%, leaving the Vancouver-based miner worth $16 billion and 44% below its high.

The damage is uneven over a longer horizon. Newmont is still up a third over the past 12 months and Barrick 15%, but Kinross is down 14% from a year ago, and Coeur 28%.

(With files from Reuters and Bloomberg)

items.title: Rio Tinto eyes 56% CEO pay hike amid talent crunch
items.author: Cecilia Jamasmie
items.creator: Cecilia Jamasmie
items.summary: Miner plans to expand executive pay as competition for top leaders intensifies across global markets.
items.body:
Rio Tinto eyes 56% CEO pay hike amid talent crunch

Cecilia Jamasmie | October 28, 2026 | 3:56 am
Careers   Education   Markets   Top Companies   Africa   Australia   Canada   Latin America   USA   Copper   Iron Ore   Lithium   Nickel  

Former CEO Jakob Stausholm and new CEO Simon Trott. ( Image courtesy of Stausholm’s LinkedIn. )

Rio Tinto (ASX, LON: RIO) is seeking shareholder support for a 56% increase in chief executive Simon Trott’s target compensation to £9.8 million ($13.06 million) next year as competition for senior executives intensifies across the mining industry.

The miner proposes raising long-term incentives to nine times Trott’s base salary from five times currently, potentially lifting his maximum annual compensation above £18 million ($24 million) if he meets the highest performance targets.

“This is designed to drive business performance in the interests of shareholders, support the delivery of Rio Tinto’s long-term strategy, and attract and retain strong leadership in a competitive global market,” remuneration committee chair Ben Wyatt told Reuters.

The proposal reflects a broader shift in executive recruitment as mining companies compete with other industries for leaders capable of improving operational performance, controlling costs and navigating increasingly complex global businesses.

Broader pay benchmarks

Rio Tinto has expanded the group of companies it uses to benchmark executive compensation beyond mining to include oil and gas, engineering and manufacturing businesses such as BP (LON, NYSE: BP), Shell (LON, NYSE: SHEL), Caterpillar (NYSE: CAT) and Rolls-Royce (LON: RR).

The proposed target package exceeds those of mining peers but remains below the median of the broader comparison group. Trott’s maximum potential compensation would sit just below the median of the 19 companies Rio considers peers.

Wyatt said Trott’s fixed salary would remain unchanged, with the proposed increases tied to multiyear business performance and shareholder returns. The changes would also place greater emphasis on management decisions rather than volatile commodity prices.

Rio Tinto targets $10B assets selloff as Trott resets the miner

Rio is consulting investors before submitting a final remuneration policy for a vote at next year’s annual general meeting.

The changes could face scrutiny from shareholders weighing higher executive rewards against company performance. One shareholder suggested the proposal could also encourage rival miners, including BHP (ASX: BHP), to reconsider their compensation structures.

Trott became chief executive in August 2025 after an internal leadership contest to replace Jakob Stausholm. His appointment came with a 5% increase in base salary to £1.4 million and £610,000 in relocation expenses to move from Perth, where he oversaw Rio’s iron ore operations, to London.

Rio Tinto pumps $1.4B into lithium projects in Argentina

Since taking the top job, Trott has pledged to improve operating performance, reduce costs and release capital through asset sales. He also led unsuccessful merger discussions with Glencore (LON: GLEN)  earlier this year.

Executive talent race

Rio’s proposal comes amid a wider escalation in executive compensation among major British companies, particularly as employers seek to narrow the pay gap with US competitors.

Median CEO compensation among FTSE 100 companies rose 18% year-on-year to £5.89 million in 2025, according to an April report by Deloitte .

Pay has climbed particularly sharply in Britain’s aerospace, engineering and manufacturing sectors over the past two years. Nearly 60% of FTSE 350 companies proposed compensation increases during this year’s annual meeting season, according to proxy advisory firm Glass Lewis.

Competition is also reshaping leadership teams within mining, where companies developing energy transition metals are recruiting executives with experience managing large international operations.

BHP executive Rag Udd is leaving to become CEO of Albemarle (NYSE: ALB), while French miner Eramet approached Rio Tinto executive Jerome Pecresse about its top position within the past year, according to Reuters .

Albemarle taps BHP veteran Udd as next CEO

Both Albemarle and Eramet are developing lithium projects to supply the electric vehicle battery market, where technical expertise and operational leadership remain important to long-term growth.

Executive pay proposals can also face shareholder resistance. Last year, Anglo American (LON: AAL) withdrew a plan to guarantee substantial bonuses for senior executives tied to its merger with Teck Resources (TSX:TECK.A | TECK.B).

Still, some investors see higher compensation as a way to improve performance.

“As long as it is aligned with shareholders, I’m quite happy,” George Cheveley, portfolio manager at Rio Tinto shareholder Ninety One, told Reuters when asked about executive pay in mining.

items.title: XAUUSD: Gold Reclaims $4,000 as Fed Week Begins. Silver Sinks to 2026 Lows
items.summary: Bullion rebounds after its worst week since June as softer oil prices offer relief. 📈 Buyers return after a difficult week Spot gold XAUUSD recovered about 0.4% to $4,010 an ounce early Monday, ...
items.body:
News
/ TradingView
/ XAUUSD: Gold Reclaims $4,000 as Fed Week Begins. Silver Sinks to 2026 Lows

XAUUSD: Gold Reclaims $4,000 as Fed Week Begins. Silver Sinks to 2026 Lows 2 min read

XAUUSD
Key points:
Gold prices cross back above $4,000
Fed week to define market sentiment
Silver languishes at a 2026 bottom

Bullion rebounds after its worst week since June as softer oil prices offer relief.
📈 Buyers return after a difficult week
Spot gold XAUUSD recovered about 0.4% to $4,010 an ounce early Monday, reclaiming the $4,000 threshold after initially trading below it.
The rebound follows a roughly 4% weekly decline, gold’s steepest since June. Friday’s selling took bullion to its lowest level since mid-July.
Silver also recovered, rising 0.6% to $54.15, but still hovering at a low not seen since November 2025. Its outlook has an additional complication: industrial demand makes it sensitive to economic growth alongside interest rates and investment flows.
🏦 Oil and interest rates shape the outlook
Softer oil prices provided some breathing room. Brent retreated toward $115 following reports of Qatari mediation efforts in Tehran, although ongoing attacks in Saudi Arabia kept supply concerns alive.
An energy shock can raise both defensive demand and inflation expectations in the gold market, leaving the anticipated central-bank response especially important.
The Fed is widely expected to hold rates Wednesday, while traders assigned a 75% probability to a December increase in the latest snapshot.
Gold pays no interest, so expectations of higher borrowing costs can increase the appeal of interest-bearing alternatives and restrain bullion even during periods of geopolitical uncertainty.
🤑 Dollar’s impact on gold
Lower Treasury yields and a softer dollar offered counterweights. The US 10-year yield traded near 4.97%, while the dollar index eased toward 101.64.
Dollar weakness can make bullion less expensive for overseas buyers, but a lasting recovery also depends on how yields and inflation expectations evolve together.
Thursday brings another major test after the Fed announcement. September PCE inflation and the first estimate of third-quarter US GDP arrive at 8:30 a.m. ET. Economists expect core PCE inflation around 3.1% annually.
📊 Holding $4,000 becomes the immediate challenge
Friday’s low near $3,975 is the nearest clearly observed downside reference. Holding above it would preserve the possibility of a recovery, while a sustained break beneath it would extend the recent sequence of losses.
Lower prices are attracting some physical buyers. Reuters reported stronger Indian purchases during the Dussehra festival last week, while Chinese demand remained steady despite cautious jewelry spending.
That offers a source of underlying support, although this week’s immediate direction is likely to depend heavily on policy guidance, yields and the dollar.
